text: Developing a mobile app requires careful planning and diverse skills. One crucial aspect is responsive design, ensuring the interface looks great and functions smoothly on different screen sizes, from small phones to large tablets. Another major decision is choosing between native and cross-platform development. Native apps, built specifically for iOS or Android, often offer peak performance and full access to device features, but require separate codebases. Cross-platform tools, like Flutter or React Native, allow one codebase for both platforms, saving time and money, though they may occasionally lag in performance. Finally, distributing apps through official app stores like the Apple App Store or Google Play is essential for reaching users. These platforms enforce strict guidelines, and your app must pass review before becoming publicly available.
